core_claim.P: The rebalanceFunds() function in FastAccessVault has no access control (unlike onlyOwner/onlyIssuer functions) and performs token transfers and emits events triggering off-chain custodian actions, with no rate limiting.
core_claim.I: Any address must be prevented from triggering vault rebalancing operations (front-running legitimate rebalancing, manipulating fund transfers to the custodian, and spamming the function).
core_claim.V: Any address can call rebalanceFunds(), enabling unauthorized vault rebalancing, front-running of legitimate rebalancing calls, manipulation of fund transfers to the custodian, and spam/griefing via event flooding and wasted gas.

distinct_impacts.description: Attackers front-run legitimate rebalancing operations to control when excess DLF tokens are transferred to the custodian, disrupting the vault's buffer management.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: Attackers can front-run legitimate rebalancing operations to control when excess DLF tokens are transferred to the custodian, disrupting the FastAccessVault's buffer management

distinct_impacts.description: Front-running causes the custodian's off-chain event monitoring system to miss legitimate rebalancing signals.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: causing the custodian's off-chain event monitoring system to miss legitimate rebalancing signals

distinct_impacts.description: Unlimited spam calls flood TopUpRequestedFromCustodian and ExcessFundsTransferredToCustodian events, creating a denial-of-service vector against the custodian's infrastructure.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: unlimited spam calls flood `TopUpRequestedFromCustodian` and `ExcessFundsTransferredToCustodian` events, creating a denial-of-service vector against the custodian's infrastructure

distinct_impacts.description: Spamming the function griefs the system by flooding event logs and wasting gas.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: spam the function to grief the system by flooding event logs and wasting gas

distinct_impacts.description: The function performs actual token transfers to the custodian address when the vault is overfunded, and emits events that trigger off-chain custodian actions.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: The function performs actual token transfers (line 176) when the vault is overfunded, moving funds to the custodian address.

distinct_impacts.description: The function reads live on-chain state (getCollateralUnderCustody()) that can change between calls, making timing critical.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: The function reads live on-chain state (`getCollateralUnderCustody()`) that can change between calls, making timing critical.
